_what: Fork `politics`: values PROGRAMME.md, POLITICS.md and RESIDUAL.md choose rather than measure, and the external documents they read, pinned.

politics_iltsvind_mg_l.reason: The bottom-water oxygen threshold Danish marine monitoring uses for oxygen deficit (iltsvind); the hypothesis register's observable O1 is defined by it. A definition, not a measurement.

politics_terrain_window_m.reason: The smallest local window scripts/terraincheck.py scores flooded and street cells against (its WINDOWS).

politics_terrain_window_wide_m.reason: The largest local window in scripts/terraincheck.py's WINDOWS.

politics_rivermap_near_m.reason: The distance scripts/rivermap.py uses (NEAR_M) for a flood path being near a planned route.

politics_rivermap_deep_m.reason: The modelled depth scripts/rivermap.py requires for a corridor candidate: band 4 of the flood sheets' legend, which starts at half a metre.

politics_pipe_end_near_m.reason: The distance scripts/architecture.py uses for its count of planned pipe segments with an end near the shore or the harbour.

politics_manhole_spacing_m.reason: A typical spacing between manholes on a Copenhagen street, taken as the length of one bored shot. Stated for scale; not measured by this project.

politics_scour_lo_m_s.reason: The lower end of the self-cleansing velocity range commonly used in gravity-sewer design. A design convention, not measured by this project.

politics_scour_hi_m_s.reason: The upper end of the self-cleansing velocity range commonly used in gravity-sewer design. A design convention, not measured by this project.

politics_rain_threshold_a_mm.reason: A rainfall-intensity threshold scripts/streams.py tabulates hours against (a key of rain_record.hours_per_year_at_or_above_mm).

politics_rain_threshold_b_mm.reason: A rainfall-intensity threshold scripts/streams.py tabulates hours against (a key of rain_record.hours_per_year_at_or_above_mm).

politics_pond_size_lean.reason: Stormwater treatment areas are conventionally sized at a few per cent of the impervious area draining to them; this is the lean end, a wet pond. A design convention, not measured by this project.

politics_pond_size_b.reason: A point inside the conventional sizing range for stormwater treatment areas. A design convention, not measured by this project.

politics_pond_size_c.reason: A point inside the conventional sizing range for stormwater treatment areas. A design convention, not measured by this project.

politics_pond_size_generous.reason: The generous, wetland-type end of the conventional sizing range for stormwater treatment areas. A design convention, not measured by this project.

politics_cell_fill_mm.reason: An accumulated sediment depth at which a pond cell is taken to need dredging. Stated for scale.

politics_bore_rate_lo_kr_m.reason: The low end of the price per metre of a guided bored rain line. An order-of-magnitude cost in Danish kroner, stated by the author of PROGRAMME.md so that a utility's real numbers can replace it. No tender was sought and it is not a quote.

politics_shop_headline_gbp_bn.reason: The headline figure in RESIDUAL.md's worked analogy of a supermarket's shrinkage, in billions of pounds. Illustrative; the page does not claim it as a statistic and this project has not checked any retail figure.

politics_shop_turnover_gbp.reason: An illustrative annual turnover for the analogy's shop, in pounds, chosen so the arithmetic of a residual is easy to follow. Not data.

politics_shop_shrinkage_gbp.reason: An illustrative annual shrinkage for the analogy's shop, in pounds, chosen small against its turnover as shrinkage is. Not data.

politics_shop_error.reason: An illustrative relative error in each of the analogy's records, chosen small to show that a small error in a large input is a large error in the residual. Not data.

politics_residual_alt_cut_pct.reason: A hypothetical alternative to the Danish method's flat oxygen cut, used only to show what a sensitivity question asks. Chosen for illustration.
